question: Does hostingmammoth.com publish a data-retention period for its S3-compatible object storage, and is the 5 TB maximum single object quote still current?
why: The product page answered HTTP 403 on 2026-11-25; every listed page-reader pin, a raw fetch with headers and archived copies for five months returned no page text. The 5 TB object cap rests on a capture from 2026-11-03.
